unknown-type.json.rule: type is one of the seven

extra-top-level-member.json.rule: the audience is never in the event: the server decides it

timestamp-with-milliseconds.json.rule: a timestamp is UTC to the second

instance-unknown-state.json.rule: state is one of the ten of IF-2 and IF-5

instance-extra-member.json.rule: no host, address or other member

instance-id-lowercase.json.rule: instance id is i- plus 16 Base32 capitals and digits 2 to 7

attempt-unknown-state.json.rule: attempt state is one of the ten of IF-2

milestone-none.json.rule: only M1, M2 or M3 is announced

flag-captured-carries-the-flag.json.rule: no flag or submitted text in an event (FR-FLG-05)

hint-carries-the-text.json.rule: a hint text is never in an event (FR-HNT-01)

failed-without-error-code.json.rule: a failed instance names its INST-* code (in the schema)

error-code-on-a-running-instance.json.rule: error_code is null unless the state is failed (in the schema)

error-code-not-in-the-registry.json.rule: the code is not in the error registry (IF-8)

timestamp-impossible-date.json.rule: a timestamp is a real calendar date and time (UTC)

timestamp-impossible-hour.json.rule: a timestamp is a real calendar date and time (UTC)
